sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads React, the chart parts, the types, and the card and progress bar parts.
sections.why: Gathers what the dashboard draws with.

sections.name: LifeProgressDashboardProps
sections.title: Dashboard input
sections.what: Declares that the dashboard receives the list of goals.
sections.why: Lets the parent page decide which goals are shown.

sections.name: LifeProgressDashboard (part 1)
sections.title: Per-horizon progress cards
sections.what: Groups the goals by horizon, works out the average progress for each group, and draws six horizon cards, each with a count and a progress bar.
sections.why: Gives a quick status for each time horizon.
sections.watch_out: A horizon with no goals shows zero percent, which can look like no progress rather than no goals.

sections.name: LifeProgressDashboard (part 2)
sections.title: Trend and per-horizon charts
sections.what: Works out overall completion and average progress, builds a three-point trend (baseline, current, target), and draws it as an area chart. Also draws a bar chart of average progress per horizon.
sections.watch_out: The trend is not real history. The current and target points come only from today's numbers.

summary: Shows progress for each time horizon as bars, plus an area chart of overall progress and a bar chart of progress per horizon.
purpose: Gives a high-level view of how goals are progressing across all horizons.
why: Summarizes many goals into averages, so progress can be seen at a glance.
how: Groups the goals by horizon and averages their progress. Works out the overall completion rate and average progress. Builds a three-point trend. Draws six horizon cards, then the area chart and the bar chart.
outputs: Charts and bars only. Nothing is saved.
risks: The trend chart is built from three computed points (Baseline, Current Track, Target), not from real history, even though its title says historical. A horizon with no goals shows zero percent, which can look like failure.
debug: If numbers look wrong, check each goal's progressPercent value. If charts are blank, check that the chart library loads and that the data list is not empty.
